BASIC.tagline: Simple life cover for essential family protection.
benefits: Affordable term cover with a modest sum-insured range.
Lump-sum payout to nominated family members on death.
Easy policy structure with few optional add-ons.
Suitable for getting started with basic financial protection.
risks: Lower cover cap may not fully replace a high household income.
Critical illness, accidental death, and disability add-ons may be limited or unavailable.
May need an upgrade as income, debts, or dependants increase.
BASIC.idealFor: Best for younger applicants with a lower income bracket, limited financial dependants, or a higher health-risk score seeking affordable baseline cover.

STANDARD.tagline: Balanced life protection for growing responsibilities.
benefits: Higher sum-insured options for loans, children, and household expenses.
Optional accidental death or critical illness riders.
Flexible policy term choices to match earning years.
Good balance between premium cost and family protection.
risks: Add-ons increase the premium and may have separate eligibility rules.
Cover may still be insufficient for very high-value liabilities or long-term wealth planning.
Pre-existing health conditions can affect pricing or rider availability.
STANDARD.idealFor: Suited to mid-income professionals or families with dependants, loans, and a moderate health-risk score.

PREMIUM.tagline: High-value life protection for long-term financial confidence.
benefits: High sum-insured limits designed for larger incomes and liabilities.
Broader optional protection for accidental death, disability, and critical illness.
Priority service and more flexible beneficiary or payout planning options.
Can better support education costs, mortgages, and long-term family goals.
risks: Higher premiums require a stable budget over the policy term.
Detailed medical disclosure and underwriting may be required.
Extra riders still have specific exclusions and waiting periods.
PREMIUM.idealFor: Best for high-income applicants with lower health risk, larger dependants or liabilities, and a need for substantial life cover.

BASIC.tagline: Essential hospital cover for everyday medical protection.
benefits: Entry-level hospitalisation cover up to a lower sum-insured cap.
Covers many common inpatient treatments and emergency admissions.
Lower premium for budget-conscious households.
Useful as a first health policy or a backup to employer cover.
risks: Co-payments, room-rent limits, or sub-limits may apply.
Lower cover can be exhausted quickly during major treatment.
More exclusions or longer waiting periods for certain conditions.
BASIC.idealFor: Suited to younger or lower-income applicants with moderate-to-higher health risk who need basic protection at a manageable cost.

STANDARD.tagline: Well-rounded health cover for regular family needs.
benefits: Mid-range sum insured for hospitalisation, surgery, and common treatments.
Broader network hospital access and fewer room-rent restrictions.
Optional outpatient, maternity, or critical illness add-ons.
Balanced co-pay and deductible choices.
risks: Some specialist treatments may still have sub-limits or waiting periods.
Premiums rise with age, lifestyle factors, and medical history.
Outpatient and dental care may require optional add-ons.
STANDARD.idealFor: A strong fit for mid-income individuals or families with average health risk and a need for dependable day-to-day medical cover.

PREMIUM.tagline: Comprehensive health protection with higher treatment flexibility.
benefits: High sum-insured limits for major illnesses and longer hospital stays.
Broader treatment options, premium hospital access, and fewer sub-limits.
Enhanced benefits such as annual check-ups, global emergency support, or wellness services.
Priority claims assistance and wider add-on choices.
risks: Premiums are significantly higher than entry-level plans.
Existing conditions may still have waiting periods or underwriting conditions.
Premium features may not be worthwhile for users with minimal healthcare needs.
PREMIUM.idealFor: Best for higher-income applicants with lower health risk, families seeking wider treatment choice, or people wanting stronger protection against large medical bills.

BASIC.tagline: Core vehicle protection for budget-minded drivers.
benefits: Meets essential third-party liability protection requirements.
Low premium for older vehicles or low-usage drivers.
Covers legal liability for injury or property damage to others.
Simple policy with minimal add-on complexity.
risks: Own vehicle damage, theft, and natural-disaster cover may be excluded.
Roadside assistance, consumables, and zero-depreciation are generally not included.
You may pay most repair costs yourself after an accident.
BASIC.idealFor: Suited to lower-income drivers, older low-value vehicles, or drivers with a higher risk score who mainly need essential legal protection.

STANDARD.tagline: Practical all-round cover for everyday driving.
benefits: Includes third-party liability plus own-damage cover for many accidents.
Protection against theft, fire, and selected natural disasters.
Optional roadside assistance and personal accident cover.
Suitable balance of premium, deductible, and repair protection.
risks: Depreciation and consumable parts can reduce claim payouts.
Some add-ons may be optional and increase the final premium.
Claims can affect the no-claim bonus at renewal.
STANDARD.idealFor: Best for mid-income owners of regularly used cars or bikes who want meaningful repair protection without premium-level pricing.

PREMIUM.tagline: Enhanced vehicle protection for high-value cars and confident driving.
benefits: Comprehensive own-damage cover with higher insured-value flexibility.
Premium add-ons such as zero depreciation, engine protection, and roadside assistance.
Priority claims support and access to wider cashless repair networks.
Stronger protection for newer, higher-value, or frequently driven vehicles.
risks: Higher premium may not be cost-effective for an older low-value vehicle.
Some claims still require deductibles, documentation, or authorised repair centres.
Add-on cover has usage limits and does not cover every type of wear and tear.
PREMIUM.idealFor: Suited to higher-income, lower-risk drivers with newer or higher-value vehicles and a preference for lower out-of-pocket repair costs.
